review.analysis: SFMC-REQ-046 defines a software requirement for data logging, specifying that each mission-log entry must contain the spacecraft mission time at which the event occurred. The statement is clear, specific, and testable without vague terms or unassigned responsibilities. No quality defects are present.
review.summary: SFMC-REQ-046 is an acceptable software requirement specifying that each mission-log entry must include the spacecraft mission time of the event.
